summary: US-Iran peace talks remain unresolved, with fresh military exchanges pushing oil sharply higher and keeping geopolitical risk alive across assets — even as AI-driven equity momentum carried stocks to new records Monday, led by Nvidia's RTX Spark Superchip launch.
tweet: Iran halted US talks after new strikes while Nvidia's Superchip surge lifted stocks to records — now JOLTS today and Friday's jobs report will decide whether the Fed stays patient or markets reprice.
